title: The text describes a conversation between two individuals, Segun and Mallam Adamu, at a newsstand in Lagos State, Nigeria. They are discussing the recent coup verdict handed down by the Military Tribunal led by Major-General Victor Malu, which resulted in the death penalty for two military officers, including a Yoruba man. Segun is concerned about the targeting of the Yoruba nation by the Hausa-Fulani and the killing of five prominent Yoruba military officers in the alleged coup. Mallam Adamu tries to calm him down, but Segun is adamant that it is a grand design to eliminate the Yoruba nation. The conversation highlights the ethnic tensions and political instability in Nigeria.
